title: Conditions of Acceptance onto the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan
content:
Acceptance onto the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan is the marketplace's own act, and it is given against the record held of the vehicle rather than against the host's account of it. An application stands unaccepted until acceptance is given.

### Conditions

**1. Age and odometer.** A vehicle is accepted onto a plan only where it is no older than the plan's age limit and its odometer is below the plan's ceiling, both read from the listing record rather than from what the host says.

**2. Fuel type.** A plan is written only for the fuel types it services, so an electric vehicle is not put on a plan built around oil changes and a combustion vehicle is not put on the electric plan; the host is moved to the plan that fits rather than enrolled on one that cannot serve them.

**3. Waiting period.** The first included service may be booked only once the plan's waiting period has run, counted in whole calendar days from the day the plan was accepted, with the day of acceptance itself not counted, so that a plan is not taken out to pay for work already needed.

**4. Enrolment fee.** The enrolment fee, where the plan charges one, falls due when the plan starts and is not returned if the host cancels inside the minimum term.

**5. Live listing.** The vehicle must carry a live listing on the marketplace, because the care plan exists to keep a working listing on the road and not to service a private vehicle at marketplace rates.

### How each condition is evidenced

| Condition | What is read | What the record must show |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Age and odometer | The Keyturn Vehicle Listing held against that vehicle | An age within the plan's limit and an odometer below the plan's ceiling |
| Live listing | The status of that vehicle's Keyturn Vehicle Listing | The listing standing as listed or as snoozed |
| Waiting period | The date the plan was accepted, held against the plan itself | The plan's waiting period run out before the first included service is booked |

Conditions 1 and 5 are read against the vehicle on the application, and condition 3 against the plan on the application, before the act they govern. Where the listing record and the host's account of the vehicle differ, the listing record governs.

### The waiting period on both sides of its boundary

The day of acceptance is not counted, and the day on which the waiting period has run is itself inside the period during which the first included service may be booked.

*A plan accepted on a given day, whose waiting period is a number of calendar days.* Count that many whole calendar days forward from the day after acceptance. On the last of those days the waiting period has run, and the first included service may be booked on that day or on any day after it. On the day before it, the period has not yet run and the first included service may not yet be booked.
